components.name: OnePager
components.summary: The A4 portrait leave-behind (210 × 297 mm): one persona, one page, printed or sent as a PDF after a meeting.

components.name: Trifold
components.summary: The A4 roll-fold leaflet (297 × 210 mm, folded to 100 × 210 mm): the main piece for events, branch drops and the post-meeting leave-behind.

components.name: Logo
components.summary: The Seekridge lockup and mark with an outlined wordmark and transparent ground, ready for print. Files are in the Logos asset group.

components.name: NavyGround
components.summary: Flat Seekridge Navy is the brand's front-of-piece surface: every trifold front and back, and every recto flyer. Paper carries everything with detail.

components.name: Benefit
components.summary: A 9 mm line icon over a two-line outcome, left-aligned, four to a `.pwf-benefits` grid under a "What changes for your team" heading.

components.name: ContactBlock
components.summary: The close of every piece: a QR code on a square white tile, one action that says what happens after the scan, then the web address and email, each after a line arrow. Replaces the pill-shaped URL button: the brand has no pills.

components.name: EvidenceStrip
components.summary: The brand promise on paper: one moment, the customer it points at (by ID), and the data points behind it, in plain words. Every piece that shows a moment shows this.

components.name: FeaturePanel
components.summary: A white panel with a hairline on paper that pairs a line icon, a one-line title and two to four lines of copy or up to four bullets. The pillars of the message house live in these.

components.name: FigurePanel
components.summary: Up to three figures in a white panel, stacked (`.pwf-figures`) or in a row (`.pwf-figures--row`). Each figure is `tri-figure` in navy, a `tri-body` label saying what it measures, and a `source` line saying where it came from.

components.name: LayerDiagram
components.summary: The flyer version of how a moment is built: three square layer chips on the left, joined by hairlines into one moment box with the gold point in its corner. It replaces orbiting chips and glowing hero objects: the brand shows the method, not a halo.

components.name: Step
components.summary: A numbered sequence: an 8 mm square tile with a two-digit mono number, a one-word title and one or two lines. Stacked (`.pwf-steps`) on a trifold panel, in a row (`.pwf-steps--row`) on the one-pager.
